an6.13:1.4: ‘mettā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā,
an6.13:1.5: atha ca pana me vyāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī' ti.
an6.13:1.6: So "mā h'evan" ti 'ssa vacanīyo: ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
an6.13:1.7: aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso, yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānikatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
an6.13:1.8: atha ca pan'assa vyāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.13:1.9: Nissaraṇaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vyāpādassa, yad idaṃ mettā cetovimutti. 3.
an6.13:2.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:2.2: ‘karuṇā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā,
an6.13:2.3: atha ca pana me vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī' ti.
an6.13:2.4: So "mā h'evan" ti 'ssa vacanīyo: ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
an6.13:2.5: aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso, yaṃ karuṇāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānikatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
an6.13:2.6: atha ca pan'assa vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.13:2.7: Nissaraṇam h'etaṃ āvuso vihesāya, yad idaṃ karuṇā cetovimutti. 4.
an6.13:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:3.2: ‘muditā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā,
an6.13:3.3: atha ca pana me arati cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī' ti.
an6.13:3.4: So "mā h'evan" ti 'ssa vacanīyo: ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
an6.13:3.5: atthānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso, yaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānikatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
an6.13:3.6: atha ca pan'assa arati cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.13:3.7: Nissaraṇaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso aratiyā, yad idaṃ muditā cetovimutti. 5.
an6.13:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vaddeyya
an6.13:4.2: ‘upekkhā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā,
an6.13:4.3: atha ca pana me rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī' ti.
an6.13:4.4: So "mā h'evan" ti 'ssa vacanīyo: ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
an6.13:4.5: aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso, yaṃ upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānikatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
an6.13:4.6: atha ca pan'assa rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.13:4.7: Nissaraṇaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso rāgassa, yad idaṃ upekkhā cetovimutti. 6.
an6.13:5.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:5.2: ‘animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā,
an6.13:5.3: atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī' ti.
an6.13:5.4: So "mā h'evan" ti 'ssa vacanīyo: ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
an6.13:5.5: aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso, yaṃ animittāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānikatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya,
an6.13:5.6: atha ca pan'assa nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī' ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.13:5.7: Nissaraṇaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso sabbanimittānaṃ, yad idaṃ animittā cetovimutti. 7.
an6.13:6.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:6.2: ‘asmī ti kho me vigataṃ, ayam aham asmī ti ca na samanupassāmi,
an6.13:6.3: atha ca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī' ti.
an6.13:6.4: So "mā h'evan" ti 'ssa vacanīyo: ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā Bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya,
an6.13:6.5: aṭṭhānam etaṃ āvuso anavakāso, yaṃ asmī ti vigate, ayam aham asmī ti ca na samanupassato,
an6.13:6.6: atha ca pan'assa vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.13:6.7: Nissaraṇaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallassa, yad idaṃ asmī ti mānasamugghāto.
an6.13:7.1: Imā kho bhikkhave cha nissāraṇīyā dhātuyo
